ex: They have been married for ten years.

mistake.wrong: She is married with a doctor. / He married with her.
mistake.right: She is married to a doctor. / He married her.
mistake.note: married to (adjective); marry + person, with no preposition. متزوج من is not married with.

senses.def: to make something bad less severe, harmful or painful
ex: Measures were taken to mitigate the impact.
Planting trees can help mitigate flooding.
Nothing can mitigate the seriousness of the crime.

mistake.wrong: We need to mitigate against the risk.
mistake.right: We need to mitigate the risk.
mistake.note: Do not confuse mitigate with militate against.
